description: Ephemeral colosseum lobbies with durable SQL financial versions, participation claims and publication recovery; the first かいし hands the escrow to the run host room library (C1, C2, C3).

lock_sequence.note: Unique financial version; reject pending or terminal transitions.

Callback updates wallets and PvP wins through CharacterRepository, and on LeaveRoom delegates exit settlement via PostBattleSettler.ApplyPostBattleResult (tier 2 character -> tier 3 inventory/equipment -> tier 5 depot) and postExitHook (tier 2 character -> tier 8 tavern_character_status) inside the ambient SQL transaction.
Admission conflict rolls back the debit and room claim.

lock_sequence.mode: DELETE scoped to character and room
lock_sequence.note: Release departed claims only after cache publication; terminal settlement releases all participants.
Admission identity of the lobby room; rejects an already committed handoff.
The host transition commits the disbanded lobby with its escrow moved into the run.

lock_sequence.mode: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE (ascending ID, run host enrollment)
lock_sequence.note: matchRoom.Open reads the committed room to fix teams, target wins and the pool.
Unique active enrollment and the enrollment receipt.

transaction_boundaries.note: Runs under the Valkey room lock inside the run host's waiting-admission transaction. Publication (room and mapping deletion, claim release in AcknowledgeTransition) follows the commit through CleanupLobby or the next room-lock recovery.
